narrative: Published observations are available for financial holdings, a narrow 2026 trade delta and voter efficacy. Comparable politician-investment-vote and voter-group-outcome joined studies remain incomplete.

limits: Third-party estimates, not independently audited against individual primary filings
Selected S&P 500 direct shares/options only; NOT congressional net worth, profits, conflicts of interest, or all financial assets
Paper reports missing and reporting cohorts differ; members may appear in multiple sectors
Sector midpoint shares are approximate third-party bracket reconstructions; do not sum members across sectors
58-row stale single daily delta from 3 Senate filers; not a representative House/Senate dataset
Spouse versus self reporting is distinct; no proof of individual direction or conflicts
Primary original transaction reports require spot-checks, and disclosed amounts are ranges, not net worth

questions.question: Public officials don't care what people like me think
People like me have no say about what government does

limits: Unweighted sample frequencies, not representative national proportions
Question-specific valid denominators; marginal distributions cannot identify joint political or demographic groups
No district or politician join; not evidence which voter group decided an election

year2024.description: Final 2024 CES Common Content dataset, approximately 60,000 respondents

Build a normalized issue, party-ID, demographic, vote-choice extraction with weights, missing-code rules and replicate denominators
Verify final 2026 CES release before including 2026 comparisons
limits: An available downloadable dataset is not equivalent to having downloaded, cleaned and analyzed individual records
No group-level electoral influence estimate or joint issue-vote distribution is published here

evidenceRules: No individual stock trader misconduct inference without original-file and chronology checks
Financial holdings, periodic trade reports and voting records are different source grains
Surveys need weighting and uncertainty handling before population claims
Missing paper reports and unavailable respondent microdata are not zero observations
